extension.summary: Control your LAN smart home from inside Kodi
extension.description: Paragon Home is part of the Paragon TV project. It controls your LAN smart home from inside Kodi instead of a separate app per brand: Govee lights, Broadlink RM infrared blasters, Tuya smart plugs (GHome, Gosund, Smart Life) and TP-Link Kasa plugs.[CR][CR]Lights are driven over the Govee LAN API (UDP, no internet round-trip, no rate limit) whenever LAN Control is enabled on the device, and fall back to the Govee Cloud API when it is not. Power, brightness, RGB colour and colour temperature are all supported, along with named scenes you can build and re-use.[CR][CR]An optional background service syncs your lights to playback: dim when something starts, come part-way up on pause, and restore when playback stops. Every action is also reachable through RunScript() so it can be bound to a remote button or saved as a favourite.
extension.news: v2.63.0[CR]A speaker plays one thing at a time: starting a clip stops the last one, so an announcement lands when it was sent rather than after an hour of whatever album was on, and Stop is now the first command on every speaker -- a step, a dial slot or a phrase like any clip. Stopping the listener on the Pi stops the music with it. Copy the new tools/paragon_speaker.py onto each Pi and restart the service.[CR][CR]v2.62.0[CR]Speakers: a Raspberry Pi with a speaker on it plays a named audio file as a step in a sequence -- "the eggs are done" in the kitchen, fifteen minutes after you walked away. A speaker is a blaster that emits sound: its clips are its commands, so the step picker, the speed dial, phrases, the phone and Last run all take one without learning what it is. Run tools/paragon_speaker.py on the Pi, drop audio files in its folder, and Refresh devices; adding a message is copying a file. Nothing is learned or uploaded, and nothing leaves the house.[CR][CR]v2.61.0[CR]Phrases: teach the house that "make me a coffee" runs the sequence barista. A list somebody wrote down rather than something that guesses -- "I'm thirsty" does nothing. One action holds every way of asking for it, so a recogniser hearing "make me coffee" is answered by another phrase rather than a cleverer matcher, and anything said that matched nothing is kept under Heard but not known to be turned into one. Nothing listens yet: what arrives is text, so Try saying something builds the book from a keyboard today. A phrase cannot unlock a door.[CR][CR]v2.60.1[CR]Fixes a speed dial slot holding a sequence losing everything after a long pause. The slot ran under the button's label rather than the sequence's name, and a pause is written down by name -- so the first half ran, the wait was invisible on the phone, and the rest was dropped when the wait was over. A slot now runs the sequence itself.[CR][CR]v2.60.0[CR]Diagnose device search now covers Broadlink blasters, and answers the question a blaster actually raises: not whether it is there, but whether it is still at the address written down for it. It says HAS MOVED with both addresses, tells a moved blaster apart from one that did not answer -- a refresh mends the first and not the second -- and writes nothing itself. The menus also re-read the shared files now, so a device search started from the phone no longer leaves an open Kodi menu dialling the address it read at startup.[CR][CR]v2.59.0[CR]The speed dial holds ten slots instead of eight. The two new ones come up empty at the bottom and nothing already set moves. Also fixes the dial being cut off on a wall panel or a desktop window: the page does not scroll there, and the dial had nothing inside it that did, so any key past the fold was unreachable.[CR][CR]v2.58.0[CR]Every run now records what became of each step and keeps it. Last run in the sequence editor gives the counts and the detail, the list flags a failure without being opened, and the phone shows what a sequence did last time rather than its schedule. A step skipped because there was nothing to do reads as "already done", never as one that did not happen.[CR][CR]v2.57.0[CR]The speed dial can be reordered, the way sequence steps can: pick a slot, say where it goes, and the rest slide along.[CR][CR]v2.56.2[CR]The speed dial is one key per row now, full width. Two columns made every name wrap over two lines.[CR][CR]v2.56.1[CR]Fixes a blank web remote in v2.56.0 for anyone whose browser had the Dial or TV tab open last. Update if you are on 2.56.0.[CR][CR]v2.56.0[CR]Speed dial: eight things worth one press from a phone. A slot can be a scene, a whole sequence, a plug, a blind, an infrared code or the front door, and a Dial tab appears on the web remote once any of them is set. Slot numbers never move.[CR][CR]v2.55.0[CR]Unlocking no longer asks first. The permission to unlock at all is already deliberate, so the prompt on every press was a keystroke rather than a decision. Settings -> Devices -> Ask before unlocking brings it back for anyone who wants it.[CR][CR]v2.54.1[CR]Fixes a blank web remote in v2.54.0. The unlock confirmation held a real newline inside a JavaScript string, which stopped the whole page script running. Update if you are on 2.54.0.[CR][CR]v2.54.0[CR]Paragon Home can now unlock a door, where the box has been told it may. Settings -> Devices -> Let this box unlock doors, per box and off by default, because a house runs several Kodi boxes off one set of menus. Locking stays always allowed. The remote and the menus ask before they open anything, and an unlock step shouts in a sequence listing.[CR][CR]v2.53.2[CR]Show status now says what a device actually reported. A deadbolt reads Locked, Unlocked or JAMMED with its door and battery, and a blind says how far open it is -- both used to say "Power: unknown", because the screen was a light bulb's shape and neither has a power.[CR][CR]v2.53.1[CR]Every SwitchBot deadbolt is now recognised, including Lock Vision. The driver matches on the word Lock in the type SwitchBot reports rather than a list of model names, so a new model no longer goes missing until the list catches up.[CR][CR]v2.53.0[CR]What it does to each light: a scene now shows the colour and brightness every light really gets, including the ones a captured scene recorded and never showed back. Pick a light and copy its settings into another scene, or put it back on the scene's own values.[CR][CR]v2.52.0[CR]SwitchBot deadbolts. Paragon Home can lock a door and cannot open one -- there is no unlock anywhere in the add-on, so no scene, schedule, sequence or phone can withdraw a bolt. It shows locked, unlocked or jammed, takes a Lock step in a sequence, and is passed over by every "switch everything off".[CR][CR]v2.51.1[CR]A SwitchBot search now names what it passed over, so a device the driver does not handle -- a lock, a bot, a sensor -- can be told apart from one that never paired.[CR][CR]v2.51.0[CR]The remote no longer makes numbers up. Every dimmable light showed 60% and every blind 50% whatever they were doing; now an unknown one reads "--", and what Paragon Home last set is shown marked SET until the device is asked. Move a blind from the phone and the figure changes at once instead of waiting for a refresh.[CR][CR]v2.50.0[CR]Skip what is already done: a sequence can ask each device where it is and leave alone whatever is already there, so closing blinds that are shut runs no motors. Off by default -- it asks over the network, and it trusts what each device reports. Only blinds and plain on/off can be checked; anything that cannot be answered is done rather than skipped.[CR][CR]v2.49.0[CR]A step can now run another sequence. Write "Blinds Down" once and put it in the shutdown, instead of five blinds in every sequence that wants them closed. Nothing can reach itself, renaming takes every step naming it along, and a long pause inside a nested sequence is handed back like any other.[CR][CR]v2.48.2[CR]The status line at the top now answers in the page orange rather than teal, so Working and what came of it read as one action. A failure is still red.[CR][CR]v2.48.1[CR]A sequence waiting out a long pause now lights up in the same ember as the channel you are watching, rather than a colour of its own.[CR][CR]v2.48.0[CR]A pause of half a minute or more no longer holds the box. A sequence stops at a long pause and the service carries the rest on when the wait is over, so a coffee maker brewing for twelve minutes is twelve minutes everything else still works. A waiting sequence says how long is left, and pressing it stops it rather than starting it again.[CR][CR]v2.47.0[CR]An RF command can be learned by giving the frequency -- 433.92 MHz for most blinds and shades -- instead of sweeping for it, which turns a hold and a press into one press.[CR][CR]v2.46.0[CR]Move files is now its own add-on, Paragon Transit. Install it from github.com/Aryez/script.paragon.transit and the boxes and slots set up here are carried over on its first run. Everything else is unchanged.[CR][CR]v2.45.0[CR]Enter an address: type a box's address and walk down it, picking the share and folder from what is really there. Kodi's own browser cannot reach a box that is not already a source; this can.[CR][CR]v2.44.0[CR]A box's folder can be browsed for rather than typed, using Kodi's own Add source dialog, so every share a box publishes is listed instead of guessed at. A base Kodi cannot see is still saved, but says so at the time.[CR][CR]v2.43.2[CR]A copy no longer takes .git with it. Copying one box's repository onto another repointed that clone at the wrong history and broke git pull on the destination. Compiled Python is skipped too, and the confirmation says how much was passed over.[CR][CR]v2.43.1[CR]Setting a slot now offers the folders under that box rather than asking you to type one, with typing kept for anything nested. Clearing a slot is its own row, so backing out of the keyboard no longer wipes it.[CR][CR]v2.43.0[CR]Move files: four numbered directory slots per Kodi box, paired by number, so one press sends a folder to another box -- or to every box that has that slot set. Copies overwrite and never delete; anything only on the destination is listed afterwards for a separate yes.[CR][CR]v2.24.0[CR]Satellite mode: one box keeps the setup and the others copy it, so a house with several Kodi boxes runs one schedule rather than three.[CR][CR]v2.23.1[CR]Plugs no longer appear in a scene's light list. Scenes are lights, everywhere and without exception.[CR][CR]v2.23.0[CR]A scene applied to "all" now means the lights. Plugs are only switched when named, and infrared blasters are no longer offered as scene targets at all.[CR][CR]v2.22.0[CR]A step can now pause for up to an hour, and the service keeps cycling and reacting to playback while it waits.[CR][CR]v2.21.1[CR]Switching the lights off, or any other bulk change, now stops a running colour cycle. Previously only applying a scene did, so a shutdown left the cycle ticking.[CR][CR]v2.21.0[CR]Scenes can hold a separate brightness for lightbars, so one figure no longer has to suit both a bar and a bulb.[CR][CR]v2.20.0[CR]Phase times now match Paragon TV, which computes them from an anchor and offsets rather than storing them.[CR][CR]v2.19.2[CR]The Paragon TV report now names the settings the installed build really uses.[CR][CR]v2.19.1[CR]A rerack can now report exactly what it reads from Paragon TV, and why that might be nothing.[CR][CR]v2.19.0[CR]The add-on id is now script.paragon.home. Everything saved under the old id is carried over.[CR][CR]v2.18.1[CR]Sequences can be duplicated too.[CR][CR]v2.18.0[CR]Scenes can be duplicated.[CR][CR]v2.17.0[CR]The weekly table can be matched to Paragon TV's and stays matched.[CR][CR]v2.16.0[CR]Each phase decides for itself whether to run with Paragon TV or at a time of its own.[CR][CR]v2.15.0[CR]Reracks: a day in nine phases, each holding a sequence, so one sequence can be used several times a day.[CR][CR]v2.14.0[CR]Reracks are now called sequences. Yours are carried over.[CR][CR]v2.13.0[CR]A rerack can follow one of Paragon TV's nine phases instead of its own clock.[CR][CR]v2.12.0[CR]Reracks can run themselves: a time and the days it applies to.[CR][CR]v2.11.0[CR]Scenes can send infrared commands, and Tuya plugs have a power-cut setting.[CR][CR]v2.10.1[CR]A colour scene no longer switches every plug in the house.[CR][CR]v2.10.0[CR]Reracks: ten ordered steps run as one, across every driver.[CR][CR]v2.9.0[CR]Says whether a Kasa plug actually used your TP-Link account, which explains some plugs working and others not.[CR][CR]v2.8.2[CR]Fixed an ascii codec error when switching a later Kasa plug.[CR][CR]v2.8.1[CR]A failure on any device was being explained as a Govee one. Each driver now reports its own reason.[CR][CR]v2.8.0[CR]Supports later Kasa hardware (HS103 v5 and similar), which speaks a different protocol and needs your TP-Link account under Settings.[CR][CR]v2.7.2[CR]The Kasa sweep was covering the wrong subnet. It now takes the range from devices known to be on the network.[CR][CR]v2.7.1[CR]Fixed a Kasa search finding only some of the plugs, and it now works on networks that drop broadcast.[CR][CR]v2.7.0[CR]TP-Link Kasa plugs (HS100, HS103, HS110, KP series). No account and no key -- run a device search and they appear.[CR][CR]v2.6.1[CR]Renamed the last of "Paragon Govee" to "Paragon Home". Your devices, scenes and colours are untouched.[CR][CR]v2.6.0[CR]The menu is now sorted by kind of device, and each one offers only what it can actually do.[CR][CR]v2.5.0[CR]Multi-outlet plugs get an "All outlets" entry that switches the whole box in one command.[CR][CR]v2.4.0[CR]Drives Tuya protocol 3.4, which negotiates a session key on every connection.[CR][CR]v2.3.0[CR]Tuya smart plugs can now be switched, not just found. Multi-outlet plugs are listed one device per outlet.[CR][CR]v2.2.2[CR]Dialogs say Paragon Home rather than Paragon Govee, and take the name from the add-on itself.[CR][CR]v2.2.1[CR]New Tuya search diagnostic: says whether the ports opened, what arrived, and why nothing was heard.[CR][CR]v2.2.0[CR]Finds Tuya smart plugs (GHome, Gosund, Smart Life). Switching them needs a local key from your Tuya account - discovery works without one.[CR][CR]v2.1.2[CR]Supports the newer Broadlink data framing used by RM4 and later RM Mini 3 units, and corrects itself if the guess is wrong.[CR][CR]v2.1.1[CR]Broadlink errors are now decoded into words. Error 0xffff means the device is locked in the Broadlink app.[CR][CR]v2.1.0[CR]Broadlink RM support: discovery, IR learning and sending, over the LAN with no cloud account.[CR][CR]v2.0.0[CR]Restructured around a driver interface so other LAN devices can be added. Govee is now the first driver; nothing about your lights, scenes or colours changes.[CR][CR]v1.7.1[CR]Cycle steps now send only the colour, and sends are paced across the lights.[CR][CR]v1.7.0[CR]Mix scenes can now cycle: every light moves to the next colour on a timer you choose.[CR][CR]v1.6.0[CR]New mix scenes: pick several colours and they are spread evenly but randomly over the lights, reshuffling each time.[CR][CR]v1.5.0[CR]The colour list is now yours to edit: add, rename, recolour, reorder and delete colours by hex code.[CR][CR]v1.4.0[CR]A light that misses one search now keeps its name instead of being erased. Added Forget this light.[CR][CR]v1.3.1[CR]Identify now flashes 10 times instead of 3, can be cancelled, and puts the light back as it was.[CR][CR]v1.3.0[CR]New Name lights one by one walkthrough: each light comes on bright magenta in turn while you type its name.[CR][CR]v1.2.0[CR]Colour entry now accepts the 8-digit hex codes the Govee app uses, and says how it read them.[CR][CR]v1.1.4[CR]New Check status reporting test: drives one bulb to a known colour and reads it back, to prove whether the model reports its state honestly.[CR][CR]v1.1.3[CR]A coloured bulb is no longer captured as white when a stale colour temperature sits beside it.[CR][CR]v1.1.2[CR]Capture fixes: brightness scale detection, no more long hang when bulbs are slow, and it now reports what it read.[CR][CR]v1.1.1[CR]Capture is now on the main menu, and the menu title shows the running version.[CR][CR]v1.1.0[CR]Capture the lights' current state as a scene - the way to bring a Govee Tap-to-Run into Kodi.[CR]Scenes can now hold a different setting per light.[CR][CR]v1.0.2[CR]LAN search now probes every network interface and falls back to broadcast.[CR]Added a Diagnose LAN search tool that says why a search found nothing.[CR][CR]v1.0.1[CR]Fixed the background service failing to start on Kodi 17.6 with "TypeError: an integer is required".[CR][CR]v1.0.0[CR]First release.[CR]LAN and Cloud transports with automatic per-device selection.[CR]Power, brightness, colour and colour temperature control.[CR]User-editable scenes.[CR]Playback-reactive lighting service.[CR]RunScript() actions for keymaps and favourites.
